knownGaps: Fade-frame slideshow images (/images/mainslide/* on the archive) were never separately captured — wayback returns 404 for the same URLs. As a stand-in, the #fadeshow1 shell on the home page renders the 2011 Vimeo lineup video (see below) instead of an empty black rectangle. Waiting on closest-CDX recovery of /images/headliners/*.jpg to restore the actual slideshow.

Custom Knockout-HTF28-JuniorFeatherwt display font used by `.fontface_K` was never successfully archived (all Wayback captures return HTTP 500); it falls back to the Helvetica stack. KlavikaBold and KlavikaRegularPlain are recovered and served locally from /shared-assets/2011/fonts/.

Third-party widgets in footer1 are all defunct and rendered as static approximations: Facebook fb:fan likebox → static Like-style card, feed.php Twitter iframe → single @fpsummerfest link, StatCounter tracking script → omitted, live Tumblr feed → static link to fpsf.tumblr.com.

Vimeo lineup video (id 20397258, 'FREE PRESS SUMMERFEST 2011 LINE-UP') is domain-restricted (player.vimeo.com returns HTTP 401 off vimeo.com); the iframe embed is replaced with a native <video> tag serving a local MP4 rip at /shared-assets/2011/videos/fpsf2011-lineup.mp4 (poster from oEmbed thumbnail). Currently rendered in two places: as the #fadeshow1 hero fill and in the footer1 vimeo box.

Sponsor logos on /2011/sponsors that could not be recovered from any Wayback capture (all returned 404 or HTML placeholders): budweiser, copydotcom, digex, dulce, ems, ikea, kru, lesgivral, littlejoy, nightowls, sonic (11 of 16). The remaining 5 (new2995, newfiesta, scion, sweetleaf, urban) were recovered.

Photographer byline images photographers/AmberRoussel2.png (used on /2011/pass) and photographers/Herb_Melichar2.png have no working captures; other bylines (AmberRoussel1, Herb_Melichar5, Herb_Melichar9, ImanSaqr2) were recovered. The newsletter/chromeo.jpg thumbnail referenced by /2011/faq is also unrecoverable.

Sub-pages (pass, lineup, info, faq, sponsors, vendors, press, contact) render the archived HTML verbatim via ?raw imports from src/data/pages/2011/*.html. Content is stable but not driven by structured snapshot data — future edits mean touching the raw HTML.
